page.overview:
Who is Gleason?

Captain Gleason was the commanding officer of the during the mid-2360s.

In 2366, Gleason had heard that the needed a systems engineer, and recommended Reginald Barclay for the position, describing him as a brilliant and talented engineer.

Upon discovering that Barclay was nervous, reclusive, introverted and lacked confidence, Commander Riker suggested to Captain Picard that Gleason might have been "buttering our bread a little" to get rid of Barclay. However, it transpired that Barclay's abilities were as advertised, when his neuroses weren't getting in the way. ()
